apps.title: keyd
apps.tagline: evdev remap - the layer beneath every bind
apps.description: keyd remaps at the evdev level, below XKB and Wayland, so it applies in every session - niri and GNOME alike, even on the login screen's seat. Every Ctrl in this manual is the Caps Lock key held; every Esc is the Caps Lock key tapped. The vi-style grammar of the whole system stands on this.

groups.name: Caps Lock: tap Escape, hold Control

bindings.label: Tap: Escape · hold or chord: Control

groups.description: One key, two jobs: release it within the tap timeout (Global settings below) and it is Esc; hold it, or press any other key while it is down, and it is Control. Plain overload, not the delayed overloadt variants: the layer activates instantly on keydown, so fast chords - tmux's prefix is Ctrl+Space - can never race the tap/hold decision into a stuck Escape.

groups.name: Physical Ctrl keycap

bindings.label: Sends a real Caps Lock (OS toggle + LED)

groups.description: Caps Lock's new job needs its old one to live somewhere: the left Ctrl keycap becomes the real Caps Lock (raw keycode to the OS/XKB toggle, LED included). Esc keeps its own key.

groups.name: Global settings

bindings.label: Escape fires only when the overloaded key was held for less than this many ms

groups.description: The tap window that separates Escape from Control on overloaded keys; the live value rides in the command column.

apps.title: niri
apps.description: The global layer: everything works from the vi home row, and modifiers compose — Shift moves instead of focusing, Ctrl takes the column along, Alt is the floating exception. Mod = Super. Binds are declared from scratch here, so stock niri assignments (like Mod+Q = close) do not exist. In-app overlay: this config skips it at startup; use this site instead.

groups.name: Launch apps

bindings.label: Open ghostty (second key for the same hand)

groups.description: Single Mod letters. Return and T are both ghostty (T for when the home row wins); D opens fuzzel, from which everything else is reachable.

groups.name: Fold-out menus

bindings.label: Bluetooth menu: power, scan, pair/trust/connect, disconnect
Network menu: Wi-Fi scan + connect, saved profiles, radio toggle
Audio menu: default sink/source, per-app stream volume and mute
Session menu: lock, logout, suspend, reboot, power off (gum TUI)
System-ops menu: staged diff, upgrade timer, generations, rebuild, rollback, power profile

groups.description: The system's settings live in keyboard menus, not apps: Mod+Shift plus the initial opens a hardware menu as a fuzzel dmenu loop, Mod+P the session menu (P = power), Mod+Shift+U the system-ops menu.

Focus column right (wraps to the far edge)

Focus window above (arrow form of Mod+K)

Focus right: next column, or the first column on the next monitor

groups.description: Vim keys are primary, arrows mirror them. Horizontal focus wraps at the strip edges (or-last / or-first); the brackets keep going where focus runs out: past the edge column, they land on the neighboring monitor.

groups.name: Move: take it along

bindings.label: Move window down inside the column
Move window up inside the column

Move the column to the next monitor

groups.description: Shift turns a focus verb into a move verb: the column or window travels instead of the focus. Moves do not wrap (niri ships no wrap variants for them).

groups.description: Workspaces scroll vertically; U/I walk the strip, numbers jump. 1-3 are persistent so the bar always shows three dots; higher numbers spawn on demand.

groups.name: Workspaces: carry the column

bindings.label: Move the column to the workspace below
Move the column to the workspace above

groups.description: Ctrl composes with the switch binds: the focused column comes along. Same grammar as screenshots, where Ctrl narrows to the window.

groups.name: Columns: width & height

bindings.label: Expand the column to the available width

groups.description: V cycles the presets (third / half / two-thirds); Minus/Equal resize in 10% steps. Shift switches the axis: window heights matter once windows stack vertically inside a column.

bindings.label: Toggle the overview (all workspaces at a glance)
Consume: pull the next window into this column, stacked
Expel: push the bottom window out of the column
Maximize to the screen edges (bar stays visible)
Toggle the window between floating and tiling
Switch focus between the floating layer and the tiling strip

groups.description: Two grades of zoom: F maximizes to the screen edges (bar stays, no gaps or ring), Shift+F is true fullscreen. Comma/Period stack windows into (or expel them from) the column. Floating is the config's one Alt bind - plain Mod+S stays deliberately unbound; do not rebind it without asking Stefan first.

bindings.label: Screenshot UI: pick region/window/screen, then clipboard or file
Screenshot the focused window, no dialog
Screenshot the full screen, no dialog
Zero-UI region capture to the clipboard (slurp + grim)

groups.description: Two spellings for the same three actions: the Print family for boards that have the key, the G cluster (G = grab) for boards without. Ctrl is the window variant, Shift the full-screen variant in both families. Mod+Shift+S is the no-dialog fast lane: region straight to the clipboard.

groups.name: Clipboard

bindings.label: Recall from clipboard history (cliphist through fuzzel)
bindings.command: spawn-sh "cliphist list | fuzzel --dmenu | cliphist decode | wl-copy"

bindings.label: Arm or disarm clipboard recording (cliprec menu)

groups.description: Recording is opt-in: nothing watches the clipboard by default, so secrets are never silently archived. Arm it for a chosen lifetime, recall while armed. History is wiped at session start and on lock/suspend.

groups.name: Notifications
groups.description: swaync runs toasts and the control center; the waybar bell mirrors these clicks.

groups.name: Lock, leave, power

bindings.label: Lock - one hand, no mnemonic needed
Power off the monitors now (pairs with Mod+P, the session menu)

groups.description: Two roads to lock: the GNOME-style chord and the one-hand Mod+Escape. Locking runs swaylock and wipes the clipboard history. Idle handling: swayidle locks after 15 min, powers monitors off after 20. Sleep/reboot live in the session menu (Mod+P).

groups.name: Keyboard layout
groups.description: Plain XKB us,de - niri switches natively, no input-method engine, indicator in the waybar language chip.

groups.name: Keyboard takeover (VMs & remote desktops)

bindings.label: Toggle keyboard-shortcuts inhibition for the focused window

groups.description: One bind, one job: hand the ENTIRE keyboard to the focused window so a VM or remote desktop receives everything - niri's own binds stop working until this is toggled again.

groups.name: Hardware keys

bindings.label: Mute/unmute the mic (ignored while locked, on purpose)

groups.description: Media and brightness keys route through swayosd, which paints the on-screen display. All of them work while locked - except the mic: a lock screen shouldn't flip mic state.

apps.title: waybar
apps.description: The bar is deliberately thin: workspace dots at the left edge, status chips in the right pill. The chips mirror the keyboard layer - the language chip click is Mod+Space, the bell click is Mod+Shift+N - so the pointer path and the key path always agree.

groups.name: Left edge: workspace dots
groups.description: Each workspace paints a 10px dot in its identity colour; focus stretches it into a pill, urgent workspaces breathe, empty ones stay visible (1-3 are persistent by niri config). Scrolling walks the strip.

groups.name: Right pill: bell · language · volume · clock

bindings.label: Bell: toggle the swaync control center (history + actions)
Language chip: switch to the next layout (us ⇄ de)
Language chip: switch to the previous layout
Volume icon: mute the default sink
Clock: toggle local time ⇄ UTC (the zone abbreviation is the cue)

groups.description: The notification bell shows toasts as a glyph + count (grey under do-not-disturb). Click handlers run with a bare PATH, which is why the module pins absolute store paths.

apps.title: qutebrowser
apps.description: Daily driver (Mod+Q in niri), Nord-themed, with Brave-ABP + StevenBlack host blocking and pass-store logins. Customs live behind the , leader so the stock vocabulary (J/K tabs, d close, f hints, H/L history, gg/G) is never clobbered - case is the binding. Rows marked ● are this config's.

groups.name: Quick toggles & userscripts (, leader)

bindings.label: Toggle the page color-scheme hint (dark ⇄ light)
Toggle the status bar (tab bar auto-hides already)
Open the page's videos in mpv - the page itself stays usable
QR code of the current URL (phone handoff)

groups.description: The , leader keeps customs out of stock's way - case is the binding: ;j is not ,J. ,d flips the page's color-scheme hint for sites that break in dark mode, ,b the status bar; ,m/,r/,q run userscripts (mpv, reader mode, QR handoff).

The stock t-family is the full grammar: t, then the feature (s JavaScript, p plugins, i images, c cookie policy), then the scope (h this host, H host + subdomains, u exact URL) - a capital second letter persists.

groups.description: Upstream's qute-pass fill scheme: z l fills a whole login; u/p/o narrow it to just the username, password, or OTP. Entries are picked with fuzzel; pass-otp supplies the codes.

groups.name: command mode: act on completion items

apps.title: fuzzel
apps.description: dmenu-style launcher; also drives the btmenu/netmenu/volmenu fold-out menus. Bindings are stock defaults.

groups.name: selection & execute
groups.description: Pick with Up/Down or Ctrl+P/N (Shift+Tab wraps), pages with PageUp/Down, Home/End-style jumps with Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End. Return executes; Shift+Return executes the raw input as typed (launch a command with arguments straight from the prompt), Tab completes-then-executes when the list is down to one entry, Ctrl+Tab inserts the selected entry into the prompt for editing.

bindings.label: Execute if single match, else next

groups.name: input editing
groups.description: The prompt is a readline: Ctrl+B/F chars, Alt+B/F or Ctrl+arrows words, Ctrl+A/E line ends. Backspace/Delete chars, Ctrl+W/Alt+Backspace kill words backwards, Alt+D/Ctrl+Delete forwards, Ctrl+U/K to line start/end, Ctrl+Shift+Backspace the whole line. Ctrl+V pastes the clipboard, Shift+Insert the primary selection; Shift+Delete expunges a mistyped entry from the launch cache.

groups.name: quit & custom actions
groups.description: Escape, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+G and Ctrl+[ all cancel. Alt+digits run one of fuzzel's ten custom actions (exit codes 10-19) - scripts driving fuzzel --dmenu can branch on them.

apps.title: ghostty
apps.description: ghostty is natively keybound; the one local addition (F11 fullscreen, marked ●) joins the stock vocabulary below. Select with the mouse, copy/paste with Ctrl+Shift+C/V, scroll the scrollback with Shift+PageUp/Down.

groups.name: Command palette, config & screen

bindings.label: Toggle fullscreen - F11 added as the conventional alias of stock Ctrl+Enter
Write the pane contents to a file
Write the pane contents to the clipboard

groups.description: Ctrl+Shift+P is ghostty's command palette. Ctrl+Comma opens the config, Ctrl+Shift+Comma reloads it. Fullscreen has two spellings: stock Ctrl+Enter and this config's F11 - the conventional key the terminal was missing. The write_screen trio saves the pane contents to a file, the clipboard, or opens them in $EDITOR.

apps.title: tmux
apps.description: The prefix is Ctrl+Space (stock C-b is unbound); under keyd that's the Caps Lock hold plus Space - one home-row reach. After the prefix: one key; Alt+H/J/K/L jump panes with no prefix at all. Rows marked ● are this config's, unmarked rows are the tmux 3.7c defaults it diverges from. Sessions persist across reboots: resurrect saves on prefix Ctrl+S and restores on prefix Ctrl+R (plugin defaults), continuum auto-saves.

groups.name: Prefix: windows — jump & browse

bindings.label: Flip to the last window and back

groups.description: Digits jump, n/p walk, l is stock's last-window; this config rebinds Space to flip between the two most recent windows (stock Space = next-layout). Alt+ variants skip straight to windows with activity; w opens the tree browser, f searches titles and contents, ' prompts for a window index.

groups.name: Prefix: windows — create, close & rename

bindings.label: New window, inheriting the pane's cwd

groups.description: c creates in the pane's cwd (stock ignores the cwd), & kills with confirmation, , renames, . moves/renumbers via a prompt.

groups.name: Prefix: panes — split, break & kill

bindings.label: Kill the pane without a confirmation prompt
Break pane out into a new window

groups.description: Splits draw their divider: | side-by-side and _ stacked, both inheriting the pane's cwd (stock's \" and % don't). x kills without the confirmation stock asks for; ! breaks a pane out into its own window, * spawns a new one in place (tmux 3.7).

Jump back to the marked pane

Pick a window; pull one of its panes in below this one

groups.description: m marks the pane (its border turns red - a re-declaration of the stock bind, so the stock duplicate is dropped) and the backtick jumps back to it; j/J pull a pane in from another window through a picker, beside or below this one. M clears the mark.

groups.name: Prefix: panes — focus & swap

bindings.label: Jump to the pane on the left (no prefix)
Jump to the pane below (no prefix)
Jump to the pane above (no prefix)
Jump to the pane on the right (no prefix)
Show pane numbers (type digit to jump)

groups.description: Alt+H/J/K/L jump between panes with NO prefix at all - this config's addition. Stock: arrows focus adjacent panes, o cycles, ; returns to the last one, {/} swap positions, q paints numbers and jumps by digit.

groups.name: Prefix: panes — layout, zoom & resize

bindings.label: Resize toward the left by 8 (repeat: hold Ctrl, tap h)

groups.description: l cycles the preset layouts and prefix Ctrl+H/J/K/L resizes by 8, repeating while held — both rebound here (stock: l = last-window, resize lives on the arrows at 1-5 per press). Stock rows: Space cycles layouts, Alt+digits pick one directly (1-5 even/main/tiled, 6-7 mirrored), Ctrl+o and Alt+o rotate panes, z zooms one pane to the full window.

groups.name: Prefix: clipboard — copy mode & buffers
groups.description: [ enters copy mode, ] pastes the top buffer with bracketed paste; P is this config's quick paste of the most recent buffer (stock P does the bracketed form). # lists buffers, = picks one zoomed, - deletes the most recent.

Pressing the prefix twice (stock: prefix Ctrl+b) sends a literal Ctrl+Space to the pane for tmux inside tmux; PageUp enters copy mode half a page up.

apps.description: The keymap uses prepend_keymap, so this one addition merges over the stock bindings rather than replacing them. apps.title: zathura
apps.description: zathura is the vi-style document viewer (PDF, DjVu, PS, Comics). Case matters throughout - j scrolls the view while J flips pages, h/l scroll while H/L jump to the page edges. Binds verified against upstream config.c at 2026.05.20.

groups.name: pages: navigate
groups.description: J/K (or PageDown/PageUp, the browser-nav keys, or Alt+arrows) flip pages. Type a number first and G jumps to that page; P snaps back to the current page's top.

bindings.label: Go to page N - type the number, then G

groups.name: pages: first & last
groups.description: g g and Home jump to the first page, G and End to the last.

groups.name: scroll: the view
groups.description: The vi home row scrolls; the arrows mirror it. Capital H/L jump to the top/bottom of the current PAGE (g g / G are document-level).

bindings.label: Scroll to the top of the page
Scroll to the bottom of the page

groups.name: scroll: half & full pages
groups.description: Ctrl+D/U half pages down/up, Ctrl+F/B and Space full pages (Shift+Space up), Ctrl+T/Y and t/y half/full pages sideways, Alt+K/J small steps.

groups.name: zoom & fit
groups.description: +/- zoom, = resets (or type a number and = for an exact percent). The z chains mirror those; a fits the page to the window, s to its width.

bindings.label: Zoom to N percent - type the number, then =

groups.name: view: layout, colors & reload
groups.description: d toggles multiple pages per row, D cycles which column the first page sits in, w flips single-page view. r rotates, Ctrl+R recolors (inverted grayscale), R reloads; F5 presentation, F11 fullscreen, Tab the table of contents.

groups.name: links, copy & open

bindings.label: Open a document: prompt with the current path appended

groups.name: marks & jumplist

groups.name: prompt, bars & quit
